model.name: compartment.applyPresentation
model.description: R31.5.1 (rb-compartment) — RbCompartment.applyPresentation(mode: 'expanded' | 'bar') is the bar <-> compartment flip on ONE component: expanded = full content [] ; bar = collapsed strip | of icons / verb-buttons derived from the SAME content. Branches ONLY presentation CSS - content + behavior are FIXED (NOT two components; the What-bar / changebar / Actions-bar are all rb-compartment[presentation=bar]). Reactive on the 'presentation' attr. Content is HOSTED via slot/children (not a Method); bar-render is a private helper (not a Method). Singular-chain (#27/#38): ONE public method -> ONE UC. AC-INV-PRESENTATION (R31.5.8): the SAME instance in either mode passes the SAME functional tests. Architect topology commit 7d5511b71.
